identity.name: Type 6D Black Dial
identity.one_liner: Naoya Hida's 38mm dress watch with a hand-made movement, made in his small Tokyo atelier — 50 pieces a year, sold by word of mouth, the most-cited Asian independent.

provenance_events.description: Naoya Hida (ex-Patek Philippe) releases the Type 6D in his Tokyo atelier — 38mm steel, hand-made NH-1 movement, 50 pieces a year, no dealer network.

narrative.story: Naoya Hida worked at Patek Philippe and Philippe Dufour before starting his own atelier in Tokyo. The Type 6D is his most-photographed piece: 38mm steel dress watch with a hand-made NH-1 movement (a Patek-style architecture with a free-sprung balance, hand-bevelled bridges, and a hand-engraved balance cock).
narrative.collector_notes: The NH-1 movement is hand-finished in the traditional Patek way — black polished steel, hand-bevelled bridges, hand-engraved balance cock.
